sections.h2: Agmarknet and eNAM put the national lemon average ₹5,500 a quintal apart

chart.title: Two official platforms put the national lemon average at ₹8,071 and ₹13,536 a quintal
chart.sub: National average lemon price, ₹ per quintal, from two government platforms on different dates.
chart.source: Agmarknet (data.gov.in), 18 August 2026; eNAM, early August 2026 snapshot.

sections.means: The two official platforms disagree on the national lemon average because they sample different mandis and calculate modal price differently.
